system.description:
Built on Project FU's Predator (Dr. Razno) -- may be Guise or Innate.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points — activated.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

PARASITE SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000176]{Blood Is Life} 【Max SL 6】

When a creature's spell includes you among its targets, the caster may spend up to (SL) HP: you recover 2 HP per HP spent, or shed one status per 3 HP. When an offensive spell includes you, you may spend up to (SL) HP to deal 2 dark damage per HP back at the caster — 3 per HP at level 40+.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000177]{Children of the Night} 【Max SL 1】

Communicate with beast, demon and undead creatures. A mindless undead can be read for whether it is commanded, and what its orders are.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000178]{Dark Hunger} 【Max SL 5】

Choose a Craving: Mesmerizing (dazed, MP-primary), Pestilent (weak, HP-primary; printed Miasmic), Terrifying (shaken, MP-primary) or Inevitable (slow, HP-primary). First infliction of its status on an unmarked creature each scene marks it and pays (SL × 5) primary or (SL × 3) secondary; at SL3+ the Craving's second status also triggers. Marks vanish at scene's end. Undead and constructs are not meals (house ruling — not in print).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000179]{Drink Deeply} 【Max SL 2】

Your Craving's active half (its own SL): Mesmerizing — 5 MP on an Opposed Check inflicts dazed, subtly (+SL to stay unnoticed); Pestilent — 5 MP at round start, every weak creature, friend or foe, takes (SL × 2) poison (× 4 at level 40+) and you recover half as HP; Terrifying — +(SL) damage per shaken creature in the scene, friend or foe; Inevitable — in a chase, spend up to (SL × 20) MP: per 20, inflict slow or fill a pursuit-clock section.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000180]{It Won't Die!} 【Max SL 5】

After your first surrender in a scene, at the start of a later round spend 1 Fabula Point to rise with (Crisis value + SL × 2) HP. Surrender's consequence still lands, and the wrong-way point ticks the Miasma Clock. Fall to 0 again and you leave the scene — cleanly, no further payout.
